name: Glen Williams
source:
Douglas' little brother! Sadly his brother hates him!
A violinist, and quite the cinnamon roll. Doesn't know the world is harsh, yet. Pst, here's a secret. He wants to win Douglas' affection... He probably has a brother complex after all... Glen is a sweet and innocent boy, who likes cheeseburgers
